findings.title: Team admin and owner check combined with `&&` instead of `||`
findings.description: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. The variable name and its use in the permission check (`!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee`) both indicate "admin or owner". With `&&`, a team admin who is not an owner is rejected. Anyone who is only an owner is also rejected unless they are also an admin. The operator should be `||`. As written, this is an access-control defect on a mutation.

findings.title: Email notifications receive the raw input list instead of the filtered list
findings.description: The handler builds `uniqueGuests` by dropping existing attendees and blacklisted addresses, and uses it to create the attendee records. It then calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`, passing the unfiltered `guests` input. In `packages/emails/email-manager.ts#sendAddGuestsEmails`, `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` decides which attendees receive the "new event scheduled" email. Any address the user submitted that was already an attendee, or was blacklisted, will be treated as new and receive the scheduled-event email. The argument should probably be `uniqueGuests`.
